correctness.rationale: For the ordinary matching complex Match(KG(5,2)), not Match(K5), the independently reconstructed signed rational simplicial boundary matrices have dimensions (15,75,145,90,6) and exact ranks (14,61,79,6). An independent exact rational nullspace basis of the 90-column third boundary and signed actions of every one of 120 elements of S5 give character pairs H2,H3 by cycle type: (1^5):(5,5), (2,1^3):(-3,1), (2^2,1):(1,1), (3,1^2):(2,-1), (3,2):(0,1), (4,1):(-1,-1), (5):(0,0). These equal sgn times the five-point permutation character in H2 and the pair-incidence-kernel Specht character S^(3,2) in H3; all other reduced rational homology is zero. Exact averaging yields no full-group invariant and one degree-two A5-invariant. This is complete finite reconstruction, not unverified reliance on the supplied certificate.

value.rationale: The Petersen graph is a canonical automorphism-rich graph. Distinguishing its reducible sign-twisted degree-two module from the irreducible degree-three Specht module and resolving S5/A5 quotient homology are complete natural equivariant invariants not implied by the previously known equal Betti ranks. The finite certificate covers all 120 group elements; the result is not presented as an all-graph theorem.
